question: What is the meaning of product dismantling in relation to end-of-life data?
description: Product dismantling refers to the process of taking a product apart in such a way that it is not intended to be reassembled and made operational. This process is relevant for product end-of-life, as it allows for the recovery of parts and materials for recycling or reuse. The ISO 59040:2025 standard emphasizes the importance of ease of dismantling to achieve the highest possible level of reused and recycled content from end-of-life products.
